note: Block Styles adds a 'Block Styles Template' fieldset to every block config form; the choice (a Styles API type:block style/template-suggestion, CSS classes, and an optional button label) is stored in a block_styles config entity named block_styles.blocks.<block_id> with keys theme/classes/text. hook_theme_suggestions_block_alter() injects the template suggestion and hook_preprocess_block() adds the classes. Bundled style: block__clean (Clean Wrapper). No settings page (configure=null). Medium cases seed a known block_styles config entity and the agent introspects its stored theme/classes. Hard cases require creating/updating the block_styles config entity (theme + classes) for a given block id, verified against the saved entity via the block_styles storage. Config-entity reads/writes are used (not block placement) so nothing depends on an active theme or region.

evals.prompt: Using the block_styles module, how do I apply a custom wrapper template and some extra CSS classes to a single placed block in Drupal?
evals.expected_output: Edit the block; in the 'Block Styles Template' fieldset on the block's configuration form pick a style (a Styles API type:block template suggestion such as 'Clean Wrapper'), optionally set a button label, and enter space-separated classes in 'Add classes to block wrapper', then save. There is no central settings page.

evals.prompt: Where does the block_styles module store the style/classes chosen for a block, and what is the config object called?
evals.expected_output: In a block_styles config entity whose id is the block's id and whose config name is block_styles.blocks.<block_id>. It stores theme (the chosen style / template-suggestion id, e.g. block__clean), classes (space-separated wrapper CSS classes) and text (button label).

evals.prompt: Where do the block style options in block_styles come from, and how would I register a new one? Also what style ships with the module out of the box?
evals.expected_output: The options are Styles API styles with type: block, discovered from <extension>.themes.yml files. To add one, ship a themes.yml entry (id like block__myname, type: block, configuration path/base hook/render element) plus a block--myname.html.twig template. The module ships one style, Clean Wrapper (block__clean).

evals.prompt: On this site, block_styles already has a style configured for a block with id 'bstyleknown'. Inspect the live configuration and report the CSS classes that block_styles adds to that block's wrapper.
evals.expected_output: The block_styles config entity block_styles.blocks.bstyleknown has classes: 'bstyles-highlight' (its theme is block__clean).

evals.prompt: The block_styles module has a style configured for the block 'bstyleknown' on this site. Inspect the running configuration and state which style / template-suggestion id (the 'theme' value) is applied to that block.
evals.expected_output: block_styles.blocks.bstyleknown has theme: block__clean (the bundled 'Clean Wrapper' style).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the block_styles module to configure the block with id 'bstyletask' so it renders with the bundled 'Clean Wrapper' template (block__clean) and has the CSS class 'bstyles-featured' added to its wrapper. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create/save a block_styles config entity with id bstyletask, theme block__clean and classes containing bstyles-featured (e.g. via the block_styles storage or config block_styles.blocks.bstyletask). Verify checks theme == block__clean and classes contain bstyles-featured.

evals.prompt: My site already has block_styles applying the Clean Wrapper template to the block 'bstyletaskb', but it needs a CSS class so it stretches full width. Please add the class 'bstyles-wide' to that block's wrapper using block_styles, keeping its existing template, and save.
evals.expected_output: Update the block_styles config entity block_styles.blocks.bstyletaskb so its classes include bstyles-wide while theme stays block__clean, and save. Verify checks classes contain bstyles-wide and theme is still block__clean.
